note: quote-anchored:valueText=官方原文,本脚本每轮验证其仍逐字在页面上;字段语义见 basis。覆盖工作经验(小时数/时间窗/TEER 匹配/国际毕业生豁免)、job offer 条款(全职/非季节性/时长/雇主指定/健康照护职业互认)、语言(CLB 按 TEER 分档)、学历(境内/境外+ECA)、安家资金(fundsMinimum 按 familySize 分档,fundsPerAdditionalMember 是超 7 人后的每人递增,value=None 编码进 basis,照 22P02 教训)。AIP 只是三个大西洋省(NB/NS/PE/NL)共用的联邦项目框架——省一级各自的紧缺职业清单/雇主指定名单不在本表,那是各省 <省>-req.json 的事。

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: You need at least 1,560 hours of related work experience over the past 5 years.
requirements.label: At least 1,560 hours (30 hrs/week for 1 year) of related work experience in the past 5 years

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: You must have worked these hours over a period of at least 1 year.
requirements.label: The 1,560 hours must be worked over a period of at least 1 year

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: be in the same TEER category as your job offer or higher
requirements.label: Work experience must be in the same TEER category as the job offer, or higher

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: have been for a paid job
requirements.label: Work experience must be from a paid job; volunteer work and unpaid internships don't count

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: not be from a self-employed job
requirements.label: Self-employment does not count toward the work experience requirement

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: You do not need to meet the work experience requirements if you're an international graduate and you:
requirements.label: International graduates of a recognized Atlantic Canada post-secondary institution are exempt from the work experience requirement

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: took at least 2 years
requirements.label: Exemption credential (degree/diploma/certificate/trade or apprenticeship) must have taken at least 2 years

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: you received less than 2 years before you applied for permanent residence
requirements.label: Exemption credential must have been received less than 2 years before applying for PR

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: lived in 1 of the 4 Atlantic provinces for at least 16 months during the last 2 years before you graduated
requirements.label: Must have lived in 1 of the 4 Atlantic provinces for at least 16 months during the last 2 years before graduating

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: full-time (at least 30 hours a week)
requirements.label: Job offer must be full-time: at least 30 hours a week

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: non-seasonal (consistent and paid all year)
requirements.label: Job offer must be non-seasonal (consistent and paid all year)

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: for at least 1 year from the time you become a permanent resident for TEER 0, 1, 2 or 3 job offers
requirements.label: TEER 0/1/2/3 job offers: at least 1 year of employment from the date of becoming a permanent resident

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: for permanent employment with no set end date for TEER 4 job offers
requirements.label: TEER 4 job offers: permanent employment with no set end date

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: at the same or higher skill level as your qualifying work experience
requirements.label: Job offer must be at the same or higher skill level as the qualifying work experience

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: Each province designates employers who can offer jobs under this program.
requirements.label: The job offer must come from a provincially designated employer

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: The job offer can't come from a company in which you, your spouse or common-law partner are a majority owner.
requirements.label: The job offer can't come from a company where you (or your spouse/common-law partner) are a majority owner

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: Work experience in NOC 31201 (licensed practical nurses) and NOC 31301 (registered nurses) can be used for a job offer in
requirements.label: Work experience as a licensed practical nurse (NOC 31201) or registered nurse (NOC 31301) can be used for a job offer in NOC 33102 or NOC 44101

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: CLB 5 for job offer in TEER 0, 1, 2 or 3
requirements.label: CLB 5 minimum for a job offer in TEER 0, 1, 2 or 3

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: CLB 4 for job offer in TEER 4
requirements.label: CLB 4 minimum for a job offer in TEER 4

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: These results must be less than 2 years old when you apply.
requirements.label: Language test results must be less than 2 years old when you apply

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: a Canadian one-year post-secondary (or higher) educational credential
requirements.label: Education in Canada, TEER 0/1: a Canadian one-year post-secondary (or higher) credential

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: a Canadian high school diploma (or higher)
requirements.label: Education in Canada, TEER 2/3/4: a Canadian high school diploma (or higher)

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: the foreign equivalent of a Canadian one-year post-secondary (or higher) educational credential
requirements.label: Education outside Canada, TEER 0/1: the foreign equivalent of a Canadian one-year post-secondary (or higher) credential

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: the foreign equivalent of a Canadian high school diploma (or higher)
requirements.label: Education outside Canada, TEER 2/3/4: the foreign equivalent of a Canadian high school diploma (or higher)

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: You must get an educational credential assessment (ECA) for immigration.
requirements.label: Foreign education needs an Educational Credential Assessment (ECA) for immigration

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: ECAs are only valid for 5 years.
requirements.label: An ECA is only valid for 5 years

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: You must prove to us that you have enough money to support yourself and your family after you get to Canada.
requirements.label: Must prove enough money to support yourself and your family after arriving in Canada

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: You do not need to show proof of funds if you're already working in Canada with a valid work permit.
requirements.label: Proof of funds is waived if already working in Canada with a valid work permit

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: If more than 7 people, for each additional family member, add $1,028
requirements.label: For each additional family member beyond 7, add $1,028

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: Minimum settlement funds for a family of 1: $3,815 CAD

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: Minimum settlement funds for a family of 2: $4,750 CAD

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: Minimum settlement funds for a family of 3: $5,840 CAD

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: Minimum settlement funds for a family of 4: $7,090 CAD

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: Minimum settlement funds for a family of 5: $8,042 CAD

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: Minimum settlement funds for a family of 6: $9,070 CAD

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: Minimum settlement funds for a family of 7: $10,098 CAD
